title: 第3章 要怪就怪前辈们把路走窄了第4章 假意服软
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
季月看出沈宴的意图，双手死死护住腰间的锦囊。
不能便宜了这贱男人！
云茵忽然咳嗽一声，发出温软的嗓音：
“沈公子、季小姐，你们别因为我伤了和气，我的伤现在用丹药也是浪费。”
沈宴按捺下冲动，表情微妙的接话道：“茵茵，为何这么说？”
云茵垂下眼睫，蝶羽般的睫毛颤巍巍的，
“我伤及心脉，灵根更是受损严重，若非丹药撑着，身体一边修复，一边恶化，恐怕早就死了，现在修复已经跟不上恶化，丹药自然也无用了。”
她抬眼看了看季月，又垂下，咬着唇道：“不过还有一个办法，可以让我恢复。”
沈宴追问：“是什么？”
“找一个和我年纪相仿的女子，把她的五行灵根放入我的丹田。”
话落，云茵和沈宴齐齐看向季月，尤其是沈宴的眼神，跟狼见了羊没有区别。
季月哪看不出这两人一唱一和，她内心尖叫，坏了，冲原主来的！
不对，现在是冲她来的！
她：“我不是，别看我。”
“不，你就是。”
沈宴温声哄诱季月，如以往那般向她索要东西，“季月，茵茵这么可怜，你就救救她好吗？”
“你失去的只是一条灵根，等师尊回来了，让师尊给你寻一根新的便是，可你不救茵茵，她失去的可是一条命，孰轻孰重你应当分得清。”
闻言，季月差点被气笑了，终于知道弹幕观众为什么执着想扇沈宴大嘴巴子！
原主的五行灵根很是稀少，要不是沉迷男色享乐，如今也是天山宗赫赫有名的天才。
她把灵根给女主云茵，岂不是白白给人送福利。

季月脑中灵光一闪，原主对沈宴喜欢得紧，最大的心愿就是和他结为道侣，她代入一下就说道：
“也不是不行，除非沈宴你娶我。”
沈宴在心中冷哼，果然如他所料，季月想趁此要求好处。
“你做梦！我是绝不会娶你这种水性杨花、处处留情的女人！”
偏偏这时云茵又在咳了，眼眶瞬间泛起生理性的红。
沈宴看不得她难受，赶紧过去想要顺她的背。
季月内心烦死了，咳咳咳，咳个没完了，咳这么久怎么还不嗝屁。
云茵伸手拦住沈宴，推辞道：“沈公子，我没事，我只是心疼你，一时间情绪激动了些，无碍的。”
“既然心痛他，那你直接去死好了，还要什么灵根。”季月语气相当不客气。
云茵愣了一下，没想到季月不按常理来，她咬了咬牙，想着要不干脆让沈宴答应季月，毕竟能把五行灵根弄到手更重要。
进天山宗的门槛可不简单。
“沈公子，茵茵想要，茵茵想活。”
沈宴听着呼唤，对上那云茵微红的眸子，心中顿时一片心疼，恨不得将人搂进怀中安慰一番。
季月虽美，但名声太差，宗门内关于她的风流韵事不少，若非他需要她给的丹药和资源，他早就厌恶的叫她滚远点了。
他再不愿，为了云茵他还是要对季月这个卑鄙无耻的女人妥协。
“好，我答应你，与你成亲。”
季月白皙纤嫩的手猛的拍到桌上，大声道：“好，择日不如撞日，撞日不如现在，我马上去镇上买成亲的衣服。”
content_en:
Ji Yue saw Shen Yan's intention and tightly protected the brocade bag at her waist with both hands.
Don't let this bitch get any easier!
Yun Yin suddenly coughed and made a soft voice:
"Mr. Shen, Miss Ji, please don't hurt your harmony because of me. It would be a waste to use pills on my injury now."
Shen Yan suppressed his impulse and answered with a subtle expression: "Yin Yin, why do you say that?"
Yun Yin lowered her eyelashes, her butterfly feather-like eyelashes quivering,
"I injured my heart, and my spiritual roots were severely damaged. If it weren't for the elixir that kept my body repaired and deteriorating at the same time, I would have died a long time ago. Now that the repair can no longer keep up with the deterioration, the elixir is naturally useless."
She raised her eyes to look at Ji Yue, then lowered her eyes, biting her lip and said, "But there is a way to recover."
Shen Yan asked: "What is it?"
"Find a woman of similar age to me and put her Five Elements Spiritual Root into my Dantian."
After finishing speaking, Yun Yin and Shen Yan both looked at Ji Yue, especially Shen Yan's eyes, which were no different from those of a wolf seeing a sheep.
Ji Yue couldn't see that the two of them were singing along, and she screamed in her heart, "It's bad, it's for the original owner!"
No, it’s for her now!
Her: "I'm not, don't look at me."
"No, you are."
Shen Yan coaxed Ji Yue with a warm voice and asked for things from her as before, "Ji Yue, Yin Yin is so pitiful, can you just save her?"
"What you have lost is just a spiritual root. When Master comes back, I will ask Master to find you a new one. But if you don't save Yinyin, she will lose a life. You should be able to tell the importance of it."
Hearing this, Ji Yue almost laughed in anger, finally knowing why the barrage audience insisted on slapping Shen Yan's mouth!
The original owner's Five Elements Spiritual Roots were very rare. If he hadn't been addicted to male sex and pleasure, he would now be a famous genius in the Tianshan Sect.
If she gave her spiritual root to the heroine Yun Yin, wouldn't it be a free gift to others?
An idea flashed in Ji Yue's mind. The original owner was very fond of Shen Yan, and her biggest wish was to become a Taoist couple with him. She stepped in and said:
"It's not impossible, unless Shen Yan you marry me."
Shen Yan snorted in his heart, as expected, Ji Yue wanted to take advantage of this to ask for benefits.
"You're dreaming! I will never marry a woman like you who is flirtatious and merciless!"
But at this moment, Yun Yin was coughing again, and her eyes suddenly turned physiologically red.
Shen Yan couldn't see how uncomfortable she was, so he hurried over and tried to follow her back.
Ji Yue was very upset inside, coughing, coughing, coughing, coughing, coughing, why didn't she hiccup after coughing for so long.
Yun Yin stretched out her hand to stop Shen Yan and declined: "Mr. Shen, I'm fine. I just feel sorry for you. I got a little emotional for a while. It's okay."
"Since you feel sorry for him, just go and die, and you don't need any spiritual roots." Ji Yue's tone was quite impolite.
Yun Yin was stunned for a moment, but she didn't expect that Ji Yue would not act according to common sense. She gritted her teeth and thought about letting Shen Yan agree to Ji Yue. After all, it was more important to get the Five Elements Spiritual Root.
The threshold for entering the Tianshan Sect is not simple.
"Master Shen, Yin Yin wants it, Yin Yin wants to live."
Shen Yan listened to the call and looked into Yun Yin's reddish eyes. His heart suddenly felt distressed and he wished he could hold him in his arms for comfort.
Although Ji Yue was beautiful, her reputation was too bad, and there were many romantic rumors about her within the sect. If he hadn't needed the pills and resources she gave him, he would have told her to stay away in disgust.
No matter how unwilling he was, he still had to compromise with Ji Yue, a despicable and shameless woman, for the sake of Yun Yin.
"Okay, I promise you, I will get married to you."
Ji Yue slammed her fair and delicate hands on the table and said loudly: "Okay, it's better to choose a day than to hit the sun. It's better to hit the sun than now. I'll go to the town right away to buy clothes for the wedding."
